questions.name: script-blocking
questions.question_text: A developer places <script src="app.js"></script> inside <head> without any attributes. What is the most likely consequence?

answers.text: The script downloads in parallel and runs after parsing finishes
answers.html: The script downloads in parallel and runs after parsing finishes

answers.text: The script runs only after all images have loaded
answers.html: The script runs only after all images have loaded

answers.text: The browser defers the script automatically
HTML parsing pauses until the script downloads and runs
answers.html: HTML parsing pauses until the script downloads and runs

questions.question_text: A student opens DevTools → Elements panel and sees a <p> element that does not exist in their HTML source file. What is the most likely explanation?

answers.text: JavaScript added the element after the page loaded
answers.html: JavaScript added the element after the page loaded

answers.text: The browser is displaying a cached copy of the page
answers.html: The browser is displaying a cached copy of the page

answers.text: The HTML validator removed it from the source
answers.html: The HTML validator removed it from the source

answers.text: The element is present but hidden by CSS
answers.html: The element is present but hidden by CSS
